ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Difference and co-existence in the Middle East in the 19th and 20th centuries Description: This course will address questions of difference and co-existence in the Middle East utilizing the central categories of race, culture, gender, class, and ethnicity. The course will provide an introduction to historical analysis through the examination of primary and secondary sources, the reexamination of prevailing stereotypes, and engagement with key terms and concepts. Finally, the students will write a research paper based on original research on a topic of their choice related to the topic of the course. If you want to gain experience in writing and in research, and you want to think outside the box, join us!
